Message:
bridge: Sanitize IFLA_EXT_MASK for AF_BRIDGE:RTM_GETLINK

Only search for IFLA_EXT_MASK if the message actually carries a
ifinfomsg header and validate minimal length requirements for
IFLA_EXT_MASK.
